207: 
208: fn find_with_regex(
209:     regex: String,
210:     engine_state: &EngineState,
211:     stack: &mut Stack,
212:     call: &Call,
213:     input: PipelineData,
214: ) -> Result<PipelineData, ShellError> {
215:     let span = call.head;
216:     let ctrlc = engine_state.ctrlc.clone();
217:     let config = engine_state.get_config().clone();
218: 
219:     let insensitive = call.has_flag(engine_state, stack, "ignore-case")?;
220:     let multiline = call.has_flag(engine_state, stack, "multiline")?;
221:     let dotall = call.has_flag(engine_state, stack, "dotall")?;
222:     let invert = call.has_flag(engine_state, stack, "invert")?;
223: 
224:     let flags = match (insensitive, multiline, dotall) {
225:         (false, false, false) => "",
226:         (true, false, false) => "(?i)", // case insensitive
227:         (false, true, false) => "(?m)", // multi-line mode
228:         (false, false, true) => "(?s)", // allow . to match \n
229:         (true, true, false) => "(?im)", // case insensitive and multi-line mode
230:         (true, false, true) => "(?is)", // case insensitive and allow . to match \n
231:         (false, true, true) => "(?ms)", // multi-line mode and allow . to match \n
232:         (true, true, true) => "(?ims)", // case insensitive, multi-line mode and allow . to match \n
233:     };
234: 
235:     let regex = flags.to_string() + regex.as_str();
236: 
237:     let re = Regex::new(regex.as_str()).map_err(|e| ShellError::TypeMismatch {
238:         err_message: format!("invalid regex: {e}"),
239:         span,
240:     })?;
241: 
242:     input.filter(
243:         move |value| match value {
244:             Value::String { val, .. } => re.is_match(val.as_str()).unwrap_or(false) != invert,
245:             Value::Record { val, .. } => values_match_find(val.values(), &re, &config, invert),
246:             Value::List { vals, .. } => values_match_find(vals, &re, &config, invert),
247:             _ => false,
248:         },
249:         ctrlc,
250:     )
251: }
252: 
253: fn values_match_find<'a, I>(values: I, re: &Regex, config: &Config, invert: bool) -> bool
254: where
255:     I: IntoIterator<Item = &'a Value>,
256: {
257:     match invert {
258:         true => !record_matches_regex(values, re, config),
259:         false => record_matches_regex(values, re, config),
260:     }
261: }
262: 
263: fn record_matches_regex<'a, I>(values: I, re: &Regex, config: &Config) -> bool
264: where
265:     I: IntoIterator<Item = &'a Value>,
266: {
267:     values.into_iter().any(|v| {
268:         re.is_match(v.to_expanded_string(" ", config).as_str())
269:             .unwrap_or(false)
270:     })
271: }
272: 
273: fn highlight_terms_in_string(
274:     val: &Value,
275:     span: Span,
276:     config: &Config,
277:     terms: &[Value],
278:     string_style: Style,
279:     highlight_style: Style,
280: ) -> Value {
281:     let val_str = val.to_expanded_string("", config);
282: 
283:     if let Some(term) = terms
284:         .iter()
285:         .find(|term| contains_ignore_case(&val_str, &term.to_expanded_string("", config)))
286:     {
287:         let term_str = term.to_expanded_string("", config);
288:         let highlighted_str =
289:             highlight_search_string(&val_str, &term_str, &string_style, &highlight_style)
290:                 .unwrap_or_else(|_| string_style.paint(&term_str).to_string());
291: 
292:         return Value::string(highlighted_str, span);
293:     }
294: 
295:     val.clone()
296: }
297: 
298: #[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
299: fn highlight_terms_in_record_with_search_columns(
300:     search_cols: &[String],
301:     record: &Record,
302:     span: Span,
303:     config: &Config,
304:     terms: &[Value],
305:     string_style: Style,
306:     highlight_style: Style,
307: ) -> Value {
308:     let col_select = !search_cols.is_empty();
309:     let term_strs: Vec<_> = terms
310:         .iter()
311:         .map(|v| v.to_expanded_string("", config))
312:         .collect();
313: 
314:     // TODO: change API to mutate in place
315:     let mut record = record.clone();
316:     // iterator of Ok((val_str, term_str)) pairs if the value should be highlighted, otherwise Err(val)
317:     for (col, val) in record.iter_mut() {
318:         if col_select && !search_cols.contains(col) {
319:             continue;
320:         }
321:         let val_str = val.to_expanded_string("", config);
322:         let Some(term_str) = term_strs
323:             .iter()
324:             .find(|term_str| contains_ignore_case(&val_str, term_str))
325:         else {
326:             continue;
327:         };
328: 
329:         let highlighted_str =
330:             highlight_search_string(&val_str, term_str, &string_style, &highlight_style)
331:                 .unwrap_or_else(|_| string_style.paint(term_str).to_string());
332: 
333:         *val = Value::string(highlighted_str, span);
334:     }
335: 
336:     Value::record(record, span)
337: }
338: 
339: fn contains_ignore_case(string: &str, substring: &str) -> bool {
340:     string
341:         .to_folded_case()
342:         .contains(&substring.to_folded_case())
343: }
344: 
345: fn find_with_rest_and_highlight(
346:     engine_state: &EngineState,
347:     stack: &mut Stack,
348:     call: &Call,
349:     input: PipelineData,
350: ) -> Result<PipelineData, ShellError> {
351:     let span = call.head;
352:     let ctrlc = engine_state.ctrlc.clone();
353:     let engine_state = engine_state.clone();
354:     let config = engine_state.get_config().clone();
355:     let filter_config = engine_state.get_config().clone();
356:     let invert = call.has_flag(&engine_state, stack, "invert")?;
357:     let terms = call.rest::<Value>(&engine_state, stack, 0)?;
358:     let lower_terms = terms
359:         .iter()
360:         .map(|v| Value::string(v.to_expanded_string("", &config).to_lowercase(), span))
361:         .collect::<Vec<Value>>();
362: 
363:     let style_computer = StyleComputer::from_config(&engine_state, stack);
364:     // Currently, search results all use the same style.
365:     // Also note that this sample string is passed into user-written code (the closure that may or may not be
366:     // defined for "string").
367:     let string_style = style_computer.compute("string", &Value::string("search result", span));
368:     let highlight_style =
369:         style_computer.compute("search_result", &Value::string("search result", span));
370: 
371:     let cols_to_search_in_map: Vec<_> = call
372:         .get_flag(&engine_state, stack, "columns")?
373:         .unwrap_or_default();
374: 
375:     let cols_to_search_in_filter = cols_to_search_in_map.clone();
376: 
377:     match input {
378:         PipelineData::Empty => Ok(PipelineData::Empty),
379:         PipelineData::Value(_, _) => input
380:             .map(
381:                 move |mut x| {
382:                     let span = x.span();
383:                     match &mut x {
384:                         Value::Record { val, .. } => highlight_terms_in_record_with_search_columns(
385:                             &cols_to_search_in_map,
386:                             val,
387:                             span,
388:                             &config,
389:                             &terms,
390:                             string_style,
391:                             highlight_style,
392:                         ),
393:                         Value::String { .. } => highlight_terms_in_string(
394:                             &x,
395:                             span,
396:                             &config,
397:                             &terms,
398:                             string_style,
399:                             highlight_style,
400:                         ),
401:                         _ => x,
402:                     }
403:                 },
404:                 ctrlc.clone(),
405:             )?
406:             .filter(
407:                 move |value| {
408:                     value_should_be_printed(
409:                         value,
410:                         &filter_config,
411:                         &lower_terms,
412:                         span,
413:                         &cols_to_search_in_filter,
414:                         invert,
415:                     )
416:                 },
417:                 ctrlc,
418:             ),

483: fn value_should_be_printed(
484:     value: &Value,
485:     filter_config: &Config,
486:     lower_terms: &[Value],
487:     span: Span,
488:     columns_to_search: &[String],
489:     invert: bool,
490: ) -> bool {
491:     let lower_value = Value::string(
492:         value.to_expanded_string("", filter_config).to_lowercase(),
493:         span,
494:     );
495: 
496:     let mut match_found = lower_terms.iter().any(|term| match value {
497:         Value::Bool { .. }
498:         | Value::Int { .. }
499:         | Value::Filesize { .. }
500:         | Value::Duration { .. }
501:         | Value::Date { .. }
502:         | Value::Range { .. }
503:         | Value::Float { .. }
504:         | Value::Closure { .. }
505:         | Value::Nothing { .. }
506:         | Value::Error { .. } => term_equals_value(term, &lower_value, span),
507:         Value::String { .. }
508:         | Value::Glob { .. }
509:         | Value::List { .. }
510:         | Value::CellPath { .. }
511:         | Value::Custom { .. } => term_contains_value(term, &lower_value, span),
512:         Value::Record { val, .. } => {
513:             record_matches_term(val, columns_to_search, filter_config, term, span)
514:         }
515:         Value::Binary { .. } => false,
516:     });
517:     if invert {
518:         match_found = !match_found;
519:     }
520:     match_found
521: }
522: 
523: fn term_contains_value(term: &Value, value: &Value, span: Span) -> bool {
524:     term.r#in(span, value, span)
525:         .map_or(false, |value| value.is_true())
526: }
527: 
528: fn term_equals_value(term: &Value, value: &Value, span: Span) -> bool {
529:     term.eq(span, value, span)
530:         .map_or(false, |value| value.is_true())
531: }
532: 
533: fn record_matches_term(
534:     record: &Record,
535:     columns_to_search: &[String],
536:     filter_config: &Config,
537:     term: &Value,
538:     span: Span,
539: ) -> bool {
540:     // Only perform column selection if given columns.
541:     let col_select = !columns_to_search.is_empty();
542:     record.iter().any(|(col, val)| {
543:         if col_select && !columns_to_search.contains(col) {
544:             return false;
545:         }
546:         let lower_val = if !val.is_error() {
547:             Value::string(
548:                 val.to_expanded_string("", filter_config).to_lowercase(),
549:                 Span::test_data(),
550:             )
551:         } else {
552:             (*val).clone()
553:         };
554:         term_contains_value(term, &lower_val, span)
555:     })
556: }

570:             } else {

575:     }

189: // Highlight the search string using ANSI escape sequences and regular expressions.
190: pub fn highlight_search_string(
191:     haystack: &str,
192:     needle: &str,
193:     string_style: &Style,
194:     highlight_style: &Style,
195: ) -> Result<String, ShellError> {
196:     let regex_string = format!("(?i){needle}");
197:     let regex = match Regex::new(&regex_string) {
198:         Ok(regex) => regex,
199:         Err(err) => {
200:             return Err(ShellError::GenericError {
201:                 error: "Could not compile regex".into(),
202:                 msg: err.to_string(),
203:                 span: Some(Span::test_data()),
204:                 help: None,
205:                 inner: vec![],
206:             });
207:         }
208:     };
209:     // strip haystack to remove existing ansi style
210:     let stripped_haystack = nu_utils::strip_ansi_likely(haystack);
211:     let mut last_match_end = 0;
212:     let mut highlighted = String::new();
213: 
214:     for cap in regex.captures_iter(stripped_haystack.as_ref()) {
215:         match cap {
216:             Ok(capture) => {
217:                 let start = match capture.get(0) {
218:                     Some(acap) => acap.start(),
219:                     None => 0,
220:                 };
221:                 let end = match capture.get(0) {
222:                     Some(acap) => acap.end(),
223:                     None => 0,
224:                 };
225:                 highlighted.push_str(
226:                     &string_style
227:                         .paint(&stripped_haystack[last_match_end..start])
228:                         .to_string(),
229:                 );
230:                 highlighted.push_str(
231:                     &highlight_style
232:                         .paint(&stripped_haystack[start..end])
233:                         .to_string(),
234:                 );
235:                 last_match_end = end;
236:             }
237:             Err(e) => {
238:                 return Err(ShellError::GenericError {
239:                     error: "Error with regular expression capture".into(),
240:                     msg: e.to_string(),
241:                     span: None,
242:                     help: None,
243:                     inner: vec![],
244:                 });
245:             }
246:         }
247:     }
248: 
249:     highlighted.push_str(
250:         &string_style
251:             .paint(&stripped_haystack[last_match_end..])
252:             .to_string(),
253:     );
254:     Ok(highlighted)
255: }
